reason: I've sunk a lot of evenings into my Notion client system and I like being able to bend it however I want. Gmail plus Notion plus my invoicing spreadsheet works well enough, so another $12 a month to move everything feels like a step sideways, not up.
objection: It looks like it wants me to work its way. I'd lose the custom setup I've built in Notion, and it doesn't touch invoicing, which is the part of my month I actually find painful.
would_change_my_mind: If it imported my Notion client pages and let me track hours and invoice clients from the client view, so it could replace the spreadsheet too.
